output.reason: A 45-year-old man reports 30 minutes of crushing central chest pressure radiating to the left arm with sweating and nausea, a presentation requiring immediate emergency evaluation for acute coronary syndrome.
output.patientMessage: Call 911 now. Crushing central chest pressure lasting 30 minutes with left-arm radiation, sweating and nausea can mean a heart attack, which needs emergency ECG and blood tests right away. Do not drive yourself and do not wait for a reply here. Stay on the phone with the dispatcher; unlock your door and sit or lie down while you wait.
differential: Other acute cardiac or vascular chest pain cause, e.g. aortic dissection
